# Lincoln Shower Door of Charlotte

> Family-owned, install-only frameless glass shower door contractor serving Charlotte, NC and surrounding areas including Gastonia, Belmont, Mount Holly, Lake Wylie, Kings Mountain, Shelby, Dallas, McAdenville, Lowell, Ranlo, and Bessemer City. Founded by a glass fabrication and installation professional with over 20 years of experience. Lincoln Shower Door installs custom frameless shower enclosures and related glass work, including glass office partitions, and does not manufacture or ship glass nationally.

## Key Facts

- Install-only company with no showroom. Quotes are prepared from customer photos.
- Free estimates, with a written price provided before the customer commits.
- Exact dimensions are confirmed on site, then an updated quote is sent for sign-off before any glass is ordered.
- Most frameless shower doors are installed 2 to 3 weeks from sign-off.
- Glass options include clear tempered glass and low-iron (Starphire) glass. Hardware finishes include brushed nickel, chrome, satin brass and matte black.
- Works with homeowners, contractors and designers on residential and commercial projects.

## How to Request a Quote

- Upload photos at https://lincolnshowerdoor.com/estimate.html, or text photos to 704-750-1245.

## Services

- Frameless hinged shower doors
- Frameless sliding shower doors
- Neo-angle shower enclosures
- Frameless walk-in shower panels
- Semi-frameless shower doors
- Frameless steam shower enclosures
- Custom bathroom mirrors
- Glass wine rooms
- Glass office partitions (a core service line, though not reflected in the company name)
- Glass pool railings
- Back-painted glass backsplashes

## Service Area

Charlotte, Gastonia, Belmont, Mount Holly, Kings Mountain, Shelby, Dallas, McAdenville, Lowell, Ranlo, Bessemer City, and surrounding North Carolina communities, plus nearby South Carolina communities such as Lake Wylie.
